description: An app of three components sharing state under a contract: loan inputs, a calculation that writes the results, and a balance chart. The canvas refuses writes outside each role.

nodes.title: Loan
Payments
Balance left by year

model.results.description: Monthly payment and totals for model.inputs.

model.balances.description: The balance left at the end of each year.

inputs.purpose: Loan inputs people edit: amount, annual rate and years.

calculation.purpose: Loan calculation: monthly payment, totals and the yearly balance.

chart.purpose: Line chart of the balance left each year.

events.name: state.changed
events.when: Someone changes the loan. Read model.inputs and model.results with get_canvas_state.
